run_gtest_help_test_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_behavior: test that the gtest binary prints the correct help message when a help flag is specified
test_non_help_flag_behavior: test that the gtest binary runs tests and does not print help when no help flag is specified
test_help_with_various_flag_styles: test help output with full flag, short flag, question mark, and Windows-style question mark flags
test_help_with_incorrect_flag_style: test that help is printed when incorrect flag variants like single dash or underscore-dash are used
